decisions.reason: Naval vessel lighting involves heavy certification and engineering investment and long defense procurement cycles, so management will attribute slow uptake to temporary causes and persist.

The spring-balanced desk lamp has its own page and fits the ergonomic office positioning, so the visible commitment favors keeping it despite being less central to the LED and light-management direction.
The second-generation general interior luminaire was publicly announced as newly arrived and is a core product line, making a drop very unlikely.
The microprismatic pendant supports the glare-free, standards-compliant office lighting the firm emphasizes, so sunk development costs and strategic fit argue for persistence.

The HMI searchlight uses older discharge-lamp technology that conflicts with the LED push, but marine certification investment and the needs of the specialist customer base keep it in the range for now.
